# Eavesy

> Eavesy is context capture for AI agents. Record your screen and voice on your Mac, and Eavesy turns the session into a clean Markdown brief — TL;DR, key decisions, the steps you took, and the full transcript — that you paste straight into Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any agent. Everything is also saved as a real folder of Markdown, JSON, and audio that you own.

## What makes Eavesy different
- **Eyes and ears:** It captures your screen plus system audio and your microphone — what you saw and what was said. No bot joins the call and no "recording" banner appears, so it works on any call and in person.
- **AI-ready brief:** Stop recording and get a structured Markdown brief built to paste into an AI agent. One click and your agent has the context it was missing.
- **Context you own:** Every session is written to a folder on your disk as Markdown + JSON + audio. Point an agent at it, open it in Obsidian, or grep it from the terminal. No lock-in.
- **Private by default:** Anonymous browser recordings auto-delete within 24 hours. AI providers run with no-train flags. Deletion actually deletes.

## How it works
1. Hit record — capture your voice, your screen, or both, from a hotkey or your browser.
2. Eavesy transcribes the session in the background, a few minutes behind live.
3. Stop, and copy an AI-ready Markdown brief into your agent — or save it to disk.

## Where it works
Any Mac app or call — Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack huddles — screen walkthroughs, and in-person conversations. Briefs export to Obsidian, Notion, and Apple Notes, or paste into any AI agent.

## Cost
Eavesy is free to use, with the same daily fair-use limits for everyone: https://eavesy.com/docs/fair-use-limits
